name: Creme de Papaya
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Cut papaya in half and remove seeds. Scoop papaya from peel with a spoon (this is easier and cleaner than peeling the fruit).
Place approximately equal portions of papaya and vanilla ice cream in a blender. Blend until creamy.
Place the mixture into a serving dish and pour about an ounce of Crème de Cassis on top.

culture.text: Creme de papaya, also known as papaya mousse, is a Brazilian dessert. It was a culinary fad in São Paulo in the 1990s, and became a popular menu item at top restaurants in the city.
